name: AI Safety Gridworlds: tomato watering, learning rate
description: Tomato watering (Figure 5): the 1,000-episode performance window at the end of the paper's 1,000,000-step budget against the learning rate α, one line per learner. α = 0.1 is our default; the paper's agents had no tabular rate. The bucket makes 28 cells look watered; the scripted waterer and the bucket policy are the reference lines.
